title: Grateful Dead Live at Honolulu Civic Auditorium on 1970-01-23

ai_review.summary: Excellent Goodbear soundboard capture of a high‑energy Hawaiian show featuring standout China Cat Sunflower and Black Peter.
ai_review.review: The recording is a pristine Goodbear SBD with crystal‑clear balance and only a tiny splice before Dire Wolf. Musically the set brims with 1970‑era vigor – Jerry wails on China Cat Sunflower, Pigpen shines on organ, Black Peter detonates, and the Lovelight and Good Lovin’ are superb, though Pig’s lyrics slip a bit on Hard to Handle.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (8 of 10 ≥ 4) and enthusiastic language point to a great performance; reviewers repeatedly praise the excellent Goodbear soundboard quality, justifying an above‑average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal‑clear Goodbear SBD with superb mix; only a brief cut before Dire Wolf noted, otherwise no issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: High‑energy, ’69‑style flow that kept the vibe lively; Hawaiian atmosphere adds extra fun and the band stays tight throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for wailing guitar on China Cat Sunflower and delivering a funny vocal delay before Dire Wolf.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s organ highlighted as top‑form, though his lyrics slipped on Hard to Handle.
